items.title: Add scanDeprecated function to audit-scan.ts
items.context: In packages/main/src/core/audit-scan.ts: add scanDeprecated(projectRoot: string): { count: number; files: string[] } that greps @deprecated in packages/main/src/**/*.ts. Return count of matching lines and list of unique files. Pure function, no side effects. Must not throw — wrap in try/catch and return count=0 on error.

verificationEvidence.note: Added scanDeprecated(projectRoot) to audit-scan.ts: uses grep -rl to find files with @deprecated in packages/main/src/**/*.ts, counts matching lines per file, returns { count, files } with unique basenames. Wrapped in try/catch returning { count:0, files:[] } on any error. Committed 3930cbcf3.

If count > threshold, append one-line advisory to the hint text listing count and files, suggesting a cleanup story. Additive only — never changes triggered=false or blocks DONE.

items.title: Smoke test: config field + scanDeprecated + advisory wiring
items.context: New smoke test packages/main/src/tasks/deprecated-gc-smoke.ts: (1) resolveAuditConfig returns deprecatedGcThreshold=10 by default; (2) scanDeprecated on real repo returns count>=0 without throwing; (3) with mocked count > threshold, hint includes deprecated advisory; (4) with count <= threshold, no advisory appended.
